Detailed Description

Broadcasts received MIDI data to its listeners.

This sits in the background receiving MIDI data from all sources and broadcasts it to all listeners.

Since this is a singleton class, commonly you would inherit from JuceMIDIInputListener and do something like: 

 JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::getInstance()->addListener(dynamic_cast<JuceMIDIInputListener*> (this));

..in its constuctor. Your class would then receive JuceMIDIInputListener::handleIncomingMidiMessage() callbacks when MIDI was received.

Be sure to remove a listener before it is deleted.

See also:
JuceMIDIInputListener
